transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. Can you start by telling me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

I'm... well, I'm on leave from work right now. I guess I'm here because of that. I kind of pushed ahead with a new onboarding launch at my job. I committed some company money and, you know, vendor time before the actual approvals were in place. 

At the time, it just felt... bold, I guess. Like it was necessary to get things moving. But now... well, everyone is asking what I was thinking, and... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Around the time you made that decision at work, did you notice your mood or energy level was unusually high—like feeling more upbeat, energetic, or on top of the world than is typical for you?

I mean... I guess you could say that. For the past few weeks, I just felt... really alive. Like I finally had the clarity to show leadership what our department could actually do. 

But I also... well, I got pretty angry if anyone questioned me. Even over little things, like routine budget stuff or minor edits. It just felt like they were in the way.
How long has this period of feeling unusually energetic and irritable lasted—days, or has it been going on for a week or more?

It's... it's been a while. About a month, I think. It started when... well, we got a new executive, and they started questioning the way I was redesigning the onboarding process. So... yeah. About a month.
During this past month, have you noticed that you need much less sleep than usual—like feeling rested after only a few hours—without feeling tired the next day?
I don't... I haven't really noticed anything like that. I think my sleep has been pretty normal.
During this past month, have you noticed your thoughts racing or jumping quickly from one idea to another, more than usual?
I don't think so. My thoughts seem fine. I'm just focused on my work.

Before this past month, have you ever had a period—lasting a week or more—where you felt unusually depressed, low, or lacking energy, or conversely, unusually elevated or high, similar to what you're experiencing now?
I'm not sure. I... I don't really remember anything like that. Things have just been normal, mostly. Until recently.
Does anyone in your family have a history of depression, mania, or bipolar disorder?
No... I don't think so. We, uh, we don't really talk about things like that in my family. So... not that I know of.
During this past month, have you felt unusually confident, special, or like you had abilities or insight beyond what others around you have?
No, not really. I mean... I'm confident in my work, sure, but... no. I don't feel like I have special abilities or anything like that. Just... normal.
During this past month, have you experienced anything unusual like hearing voices, seeing things others don't, or having beliefs that others find strange or hard to believe?
No... nothing like that. I don't... I haven't heard any voices or seen anything unusual. Just... no.
